verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a Bearer API key for authentication and CLI multi-team auth for switching workspaces. Nothing documents scoped, read-only, or otherwise least-privilege credentials that could be issued to an agent. Workspace switching is an adjacent control, not permission scoping, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
